feature: Separate aggregate structuredContent representation and coverage, shared by App and CLI including JSON output

sourceVerification.swift:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0

compiledCLIReplay.source: Previously captured official SDK 2.3.1 replies plus explicit partial-log mutations; not native Codex sessions

checks: post-run checks exclude invalid/legacy pairs, retain all outcomes and reject incomplete v2 records
serialized media/truncation markers remain separate from native image blocks and text accounting in both encodings
local missing schema target diagnosed, valid/boolean/identified schemas not misreported; no tool call or reference leakage
root-declared cached Skill counted once with an informational layout hint and no mutation actions; extensionless references checked
latest cumulative counters, decreases and conflicts stay separate from requests and tools
separate Codex namespaces group with legacy MCP names; native images excluded and same-name outer tools stay distinct
structured JSON is measured separately from acknowledgment text; unavailable envelopes stay unknown and payloads are not exported
all JSON value shapes are measured, null differs from absence, array ranking recovers and returned-text accounting stays separate
structured JSON totals cover all MCP rows; missing replies preserve the known subset while totals stay unknown
CLI text and structured token order is declared in JSON, shared with human output, preserves metrics and keeps known zero before unknown

rules: Full observed JSON total requires complete selected-log reading, checked completed results and no missing or failed invocations or unmeasurable fields
Known measured subset remains separate when a total is unknown
Reference counts never fall back to heuristic totals; bytes can remain known when reference counts are unavailable
Optional stored summary is checked against source rows, reference encoding and log-reading state; old or stale summaries require reanalysis
Aggregation includes all directly attributed MCP rows and excludes Skill/outer categories; representation caveats are shared once in current App/CLI views
limitations: Only directly attributed retained MCP structuredContent, not a complete transport response or account-wide usage
SDK replies captured in the previous phase were reused; partial log cases are explicit synthetic mutations, not native Codex sessions
375 targeted Debug tests, no full Release or x86_64 acceptance
No request/model/billing attribution or task-quality conclusion
